note: Recast from the original description of Emerson 1925 (in English), where the species was placed in the subgenus Kalotermes (Rugitermes); the description is based on a single queen (holotype) and 3 soldiers from the same nest, the type locality being Kartabo, British Guiana. The row labels of the alate measurement table are damaged in the scan and no values are given; the soldier measurements are complete.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The smallest known species of Rugitermes: soldier total length about 6.03 mm, head width 1.19—1.35 mm. It can be separated from K. bicolor, K. magninotus, K. nodulosus and K. rugosus by the sides of the thorax being concolorous with the abdomen and by the legs being yellow throughout; the soldier pronotum width is about equal to the head, whereas in K. magninotus the pronotum is distinctly wider than the head and proportionally longer, with proportionally stouter femora.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Queen: head moderately dark brown, contrasting strongly with the pronotum; head shape broadly oval. Antenna yellow, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4. Eyes rather small, 0.126 mm from the lower margin of the head, slightly oval; ocelli medium-sized, oval, 0.032 mm from the eye. Labrum yellow, clypeus white. Sides of the thorax yellow, about concolorous with the abdomen. Pronotum yellow, contrasting markedly with the dark head and wing scales; legs yellow throughout; arolium distinct. Wing scales almost as dark as the head and strongly contrasting with the yellow pronotum. Abdominal tergites yellow, the sternites brownish, distinctly darker than the tergites. The row labels of the measurement table of the original are damaged in the scanned text, so the values cannot be matched one by one and are not listed here.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown posteriorly and darker anteriorly, densely covered with setae, sparser posteriorly; head elongate, the sides straight and parallel, the posterior margin rounded, the anterior part slightly inclined, with a very shallow groove in the middle. Antenna 15—16 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and inflated at the tip, segment 2 longer than segment 4; the basal 3 segments darker than the remaining yellow segments. Mandibles black, the left with several smaller teeth, the right with two distinct large teeth. Pronotum yellow, densely covered with setae; anterior margin concave, the sides rounded, the posterior margin forming two very broad angles; width about equal to the head or slightly greater. Abdomen yellow, both tergites and sternites densely setose. Measurements: total length 6.03 mm; head length 2.89—3.28 mm; head width 1.19—1.35 mm; pronotum length 0.58—0.67 mm; pronotum width 1.19—1.35 mm; hind tibia length 0.83—0.99 mm.
